name: Futanari Alice to Fushigi no Kuni no Shojo Yarou Domo
original_name: ふたなりアリスとふしぎの国の処女野郎ども
source:
Alice is sentenced to futanari for her crime of theft in a courthouse.
Then the Queen says:
"If you want to retrieve your original body, you need to rape guys in wonderland."

Thus Alice goes on an adventure to rape guys in wonderland, 
having a bin of lotion provided by a white rabbit.

This is a story of a girl Alice, who was futanarified due to a false accusation.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE214829.html]DLsite English[/url]]
